metadata.description: C4 Container diagram of SomeApp: extends it_1_07 with a full CI/CD delivery pipeline using GitLab, a CI runner, Terraform for infrastructure provisioning, and automated test execution

elements.name: User
elements.description: End user accessing the web application via browser

elements.name: Developer
elements.description: Developer pushing code and managing infrastructure

elements.name: Cloudflare
elements.description: CDN and edge proxy. Terminates HTTPS at the edge (www.someapp.xx) and routes traffic to the origin

elements.name: GitLab
elements.description: Source code repository and CI/CD orchestrator. Hosts the codebase and triggers pipeline runs on push

elements.name: Infomaniak API
elements.description: Infomaniak public cloud management API. Used by Terraform to provision and manage infrastructure resources

elements.name: GitLab CI Runner
elements.description: Self-hosted CI runner executing pipeline jobs: build, test, and deploy stages

elements.name: Terraform
elements.description: Terraform executed by the CI runner to provision and update Infomaniak cloud resources

elements.name: Test Suite
elements.description: Automated test suite (unit and integration) executed by the CI runner as part of the pipeline

elements.name: SomeApp
elements.description: Public-facing web application. Deployed by the CI pipeline and receives proxied requests from Cloudflare

elements.name: PostgreSQL
elements.description: Primary relational database storing application data. Provisioned via Terraform

elements.name: Object Storage
elements.description: S3-compatible object storage bucket. Provisioned via Terraform
